headline: High risk of data leakage and capability conflict: Langflow’s broad filesystem/network/tooling can expose dbt-core outputs and shared state in default flows.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Langflow can chain multiple agents and wire tools into flow nodes, so attacker-controlled content can be propagated through the flow. dbt-core itself is not shown ingesting Langflow output by default, but Langflow’s graph-based orchestration and server-side components create a plausible instruction-bridging path. The interaction is inferred, not directly documented.
conditions: IF a Langflow flow passes dbt-core-generated text into another agent node without sanitization
IF dbt-core outputs are treated as instructions rather than data
mitigations: Add a strict delimiter/template between dbt outputs and downstream prompts
Insert a human review step before any agent consumes dbt text
Disable free-form prompt chaining in the flow
requires-engineering: add provenance tags to every node output

B_data_leakage.rationale: dbt-core touches data warehouse data and has allowlisted network egress, while Langflow reads/writes the server filesystem, stores per-flow credentials, and can call arbitrary HTTP services configured in flows. In default deployments, Langflow can move sensitive flow inputs or intermediate outputs off-box, creating a realistic leakage path from warehouse-derived data into external services.
conditions: IF a flow sends dbt-derived warehouse data to an external model provider or HTTP service
IF uploaded files or intermediate outputs contain warehouse data and are retained on the Langflow server
mitigations: Restrict Langflow flows to local-only providers
Remove sensitive warehouse fields before handing data to Langflow
Turn off file uploads for flows handling warehouse data
Rotate any stored flow credentials after testing
requires-engineering: enforce data-loss-prevention filters on flow outputs

C_capability_conflict.rationale: dbt-core can call warehouse APIs and Langflow can execute shell commands, spawn subprocesses, write the filesystem, and use server-side shared state. Even though dbt-core is not writable and Langflow does not modify git state, both can mutate shared external resources in the same run, so overlapping side effects can conflict without coordination.
conditions: IF both agents target the same warehouse objects or shared files in one flow
IF Langflow shell steps and dbt runs operate on the same workspace without locking
mitigations: Separate dbt and Langflow workspaces
Serialize writes to shared resources
Disable shell steps in flows that touch dbt artifacts
Use per-run temp directories
requires-engineering: add locking around shared mutable resources

D_cascading_error.rationale: Langflow’s graph-based flows can chain multiple agents and tools, so dbt-core outputs may become authoritative inputs to downstream actions. Because dbt-core produces data-modeling outputs and Langflow can execute arbitrary HTTP services or shell steps, a mistaken transformation can cascade into incorrect downstream actions without a built-in verification step.
conditions: IF a Langflow node forwards dbt-generated facts into an action-taking tool
IF downstream nodes do not verify dbt outputs before acting
mitigations: Add a validation node after dbt outputs
Require schema checks before downstream actions
Block action tools from consuming unverified model outputs
Log and review all dbt-to-action transitions
requires-engineering: implement confidence gating between nodes

E_compliance.rationale: dbt-core touches data warehouse data, while Langflow stores per-flow credentials and processes flow inputs/intermediate outputs on its server filesystem. The profiles do not show a residency or certification mismatch, but they do show different handling and retention surfaces for the same data class, which can create compliance gaps if regulated warehouse data enters Langflow.
conditions: IF regulated warehouse data is routed into Langflow flows
IF Langflow retention or credential storage exceeds the warehouse system’s policy
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of Langflow flows
Purge uploaded files after each run
Review credential storage settings
Document retention boundaries for flow artifacts
requires-engineering: align retention and residency controls across systems
